summary_points.text: A councilman thanked Councilman Flynn and the task force for the work on the Code of Ethics bill, which stays in the block vote
Council Bill 17-0156, a $4 million supplemental appropriation for a business incentive, was on second reading
A councilwoman opposed it: no direct contract with the retailer and not enough quality full-time jobs; Councilman Espinosa opposed it for lack of explanation of its benefit to the 16th Street Mall
In the roll-call vote the bill passed with two votes against

decisions.text: Council Bill 17-0156, the $4 million supplemental appropriation from the General Contingency Fund, passed with two votes against
The ethics bill 16-1202 stays in the block vote

unresolved_issues.text: Concerns that there is no direct contract with the retailer and not enough quality full-time jobs
